title: Render every declared flag in per-command text help, not only the required ones
action: `bee <cmd> --help` text output prints only a required: line, so optional flags are invisible — `bee dispatch prepare --help` never shows --claim/--purpose/--session-id though the registry parameters hold them. The text-help renderer is render_help_text in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/help.rs (the required: line is built at ~:528; the --help dispatch path try_native/group_scoped/manifest_entry lives there too). Render the full flag surface per command in the compact shape the session preamble uses (see hooks/session_preamble/budget.rs): one line like `--id*:str --worker*:str --session-id:str`, * marking required, --json omitted per line and stated once in the output header or trailer. Keep or fold the existing required: line — writer judgment — but optional flags must be visible and the choice pinned by a test asserting dispatch prepare help text contains --claim and --purpose and that required flags are visibly marked. Do not break --help --names / --help --all outputs or their tests; adjust assertions only where the new line legitimately appears.

truths: Required flags are visibly marked distinct from optional ones
A test pins the full-flag rendering
